business_problem: However, the HR team of Volkswagen Group Services was stuck in neutral, struggling to manage and analyze HR data.
solution_summary: Driving clarity in a data jam: How Volkswagen Group Services partnered with IBM and Intito to shift HR into high gear with IBM Planning Analytics That's where IBM Planning Analytics came in-a powerful tool that could help them get back on track. In the words of Alexander Beil, HR Controller at Volkswagen Group Services, "We needed a system that could handle all our HR data needs, including data integration and reporting." With IBM Planning Analytics, we have reduced the time it takes to generate reports from 7 days to just a few seconds. Our productivity has increased by 85%! Volkswagen Group Services chose IBM Planning Analytics thanks to a recommendation from their own finance department, which had been cruising along with the solution for eight years.
business_outcome: Volkswagen Group Services has built a scalable foundation for HR analytics-one that improves efficiency today and positions the organization for future innovation. With IBM Planning Analytics, they have built a foundation for agility, which now extends beyond finance and HR to operations.
